name: Burpee Box Jump
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or platform with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Perform a standard burpee: drop into a squat, place hands on the floor, kick feet back into a push-up position.
Jump your feet back to the squat position.
Instead of jumping straight up, explosively jump onto the box, landing with both feet simultaneously.
Stand fully upright on the box.
Step down carefully from the box and immediately begin the next repetition.
